[Intro]
[ch]Db[/ch]  [ch]Gb[/ch]
[tab][ch]Bbm[/ch]               [ch]Ab[/ch]
I miss, I mi—, I miss you[/tab]
Eh, fuck it!

[Verse 1]
[tab]                           [ch]Db[/ch]
This might be the hardest song I've ever had to write[/tab]
Yeah, I dreamt about you last night
[tab]                       [ch]Gb[/ch]
I only see you when I close my eyes tight[/tab]
Yeah, I wish I told you how I felt before you left
[tab]              [ch]Bbm[/ch]
But it just never felt right[/tab]
[tab]        [ch]Ab[/ch]
Yeah, *crying*[/tab]
[tab]                    [ch]Db[/ch]
I wish I told you everything before you left[/tab]
I won't forget the day that they found the growth in your chest
[tab]                              [ch]Gb[/ch]
The cancer took ahold of your body and then it spread[/tab]
I talk to you more now than I ever did—I'm a mess
[tab]                                 [ch]Bbm[/ch]
This song will never capture the pain that I could express[/tab]
I learned from you that nothing is perfect, but try your best
[tab]                                            [ch]Ab[/ch]
I know you had your demons that younger me didn't get[/tab]
And out of all our demons, our biggest might be regret
[tab]                                 [ch]Db[/ch]
Relate more than ever, remember back when I would only see you every other week[/tab]
And every other Wednesday, you would take us out to eat
[tab][ch]Gb[/ch]
Mom and you had split, so we're living in between[/tab]
Looking up the word "divorced" to understand what it could mean
[tab]               [ch]Bbm[/ch]
But I don't understand, Mom is with another man[/tab]
You been drinking heavier, to me it was just another can
[tab]                [ch]Ab[/ch]
Culture full of broken homes, we were just another fam[/tab]
Coulda left like other dads, you, you had another plan
[tab]               [ch]Db[/ch]
So you stuck around, dealt a life that you probably would never choose[/tab]
You bottled it inside and that bottle turned into booze
[tab]       [ch]Gb[/ch]
The Jäger took ahold and your body took the abuse[/tab]
But finally found soberity, cried when I got the news
[tab] [ch]Bbm[/ch]
I know, been hurting more than I show[/tab]
Inspired by your story, couple things you should know
[tab]              [ch]Ab[/ch]
I met this girl at my show, teared up by what I was told[/tab]
She said, "I'm sober 'cause of you, you do way more than you know"
And I say—

[Hook]
[tab]            [ch]Db[/ch]
And I say, "Ohh, please grant me the serenity[/tab]
[tab]     [ch]Gb[/ch]
To accept everything I cannot change"[/tab]
[tab] [ch]Bbm[/ch]                                 [ch]Db[/ch]
You, you always told me I had to do anything[/tab]
[tab]             [ch]Ab[/ch]
To have you back, see you one day[/tab]
[tab][ch]Db[/ch]                                [ch]Gb[/ch]
I, I wonder if you see me when I fall, yeah[/tab]
[tab]                                 [ch]Bbm[/ch]
I wonder if you hear me now at all[/tab]
Maybe if the world played this through speakers
[tab]        [ch]Ab[/ch]
I'd be loud enough to reach you, and you'll hear[/tab]
My last letter for you

[Verse 2]
[tab]                             [ch]Db[/ch]
And I don't understand how you would stay so optimistic[/tab]
You started chemo, fought the battle, never quit
[tab]              [ch]Gb[/ch]
That really left an imprint[/tab]
And we would talk about our lives and after this
[tab]              [ch]Bbm[/ch]
How we would live 'em different[/tab]
See, Mom and you would put your differences aside
[tab] [ch]Ab[/ch]
Every day she would visit, see the love and your vision[/tab]
See the hurt in your smile, your wisdom is what I'm missing the most
[tab][ch]Db[/ch]
I'll never be ready to let you go[/tab]
I never felt so helpless it's outta both our control
[tab]     [ch]Gb[/ch]
You told me how you wanted to travel, next year you'll go[/tab]
And your body had become fragile, not once did you lose your soul
[tab][ch]Bbm[/ch]
We were told, it was progressing and you had less than a week[/tab]
True love is every tear when we told you we had to leave
[tab]    [ch]Ab[/ch]
And how we would converse it, not once did we need to speak[/tab]
That one day in late October you passed away in your sleep
[tab]         [ch]Db[/ch]
I been cryin' when I think about it[/tab]
I miss your smile, I miss your laugh, and now I live without it
[tab]                           [ch]Gb[/ch]
I told you music was my passion, and you never doubt it[/tab]
And people tell me they relate, but now I truly doubt it
[tab]                        [ch]Bbm[/ch]
Remember cryin' on your grave and yellin' up to you, "How did I lose my way?"[/tab]
I won't forget that summer was some of my darkest days
[tab]     [ch]Ab[/ch]
Was asking for a sign, sat in my tears and prayed[/tab]
When I saw that sign you sent me, that day was forever changed
[tab][ch]Db[/ch]
I know, I know, I should've been a better me[/tab]
Oh, blame me when we argue, I said things I didn't mean
[tab]         [ch]Gb[/ch]
Me and you are who our issues should have always been between[/tab]
So I'm sorry for the lack of communication from me
[tab]        [ch]Bbm[/ch]
I just wish that you were here, so you could watch me win a Grammy[/tab]
But more importantly to build a family
[tab]                  [ch]Ab[/ch]
I hope I make you proud and become everything I can be[/tab]
I hope they play it loud and send this letter where I can't reach
Sincerely, Mark

[Hook]
[tab]            [ch]Db[/ch]
And I say, "Ohh, please grant me the serenity[/tab]
[tab]     [ch]Gb[/ch]
To accept everything I cannot change"[/tab]
[tab] [ch]Bbm[/ch]                                 [ch]Db[/ch]
You, you always told me I had to do anything[/tab]
[tab]             [ch]Ab[/ch]
To have you back, see you one day[/tab]
[tab][ch]Db[/ch]                                [ch]Gb[/ch]
I, I wonder if you see me when I fall, yeah[/tab]
[tab]                                 [ch]Bbm[/ch]
I wonder if you hear me now at all[/tab]
Maybe if the world played this through speakers
[tab]        [ch]Ab[/ch]
I'd be loud enough to reach you, and you'll hear[/tab]
My last letter for you
